propositions: Blocking links between sibling tickets are currently promoted to epic-tier by type, causing direct child dependencies to be redirected to ancestor relationships that are impossible or redundant
The redundancy guard evaluates the original pair before promotion, missing that the promoted pair is redundant; an escalated edge can record even when it violates the ancestor-descendant constraint
Comparability must be determined by structural hierarchy (nearest common ancestor) rather than ticket type tier; two siblings under the same parent should link directly without promotion
The ancestor walk is capped at 2 hops, causing deeper chains to incorrectly fall back to the root; uncapping and cycle-guarding allows correct NCA resolution at any depth
After resolution, blocking links whose resolved endpoints are ancestor-descendant must be rejected as redundant, even if the original pair was not
Non-blocking relations (relates_to, supersedes, discovered_from) must continue using original-pair redundancy and gain no new rejections from the widened blocking predicate
